name: Platform companies

subjectOf.text: Platform disruptors such as Uber and Airbnb did not decentralize their industries by eliminating intermediaries; they decentralized by replacing incumbent intermediaries with algorithmic ones.
subjectOf.abstract: industries respectively not by eliminating intermediaries but by replacing them.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176
scope_conditions: transportation and hospitality industries as the worked examples

subjectOf.text: Platform companies embrace an unmediated, flat, and inclusive culture in which trust and value are generated through the platform itself rather than through the management of workers and physical assets.
subjectOf.abstract: Most importantly, platform companies embrace an unmediated, flat, and inclusive culture.72 Trust and value are created through platforms, instead of the management of workers and physical assets.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176
scope_conditions: platform companies built on peer-to-peer transactions, such as Airbnb and Uber

subjectOf.text: Increased connectivity enabled by blockchain technology, combined with increased decentralization, allows the removal of intermediaries including lawyers, financial intermediaries, and platform companies.
subjectOf.abstract: Increased connectivity enabled by blockchain technology in combination with increased decentralization allows for the removal of intermediaries, including lawyers, financial intermediaries, and platform companies.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2939127
scope_conditions: environments where blockchain enabled connectivity and decentralization advance together

subjectOf.text: Hybrid organizations combining centralized structure and profit optimization with bottom-up decentralization in the form of customer reviews generate significant success but also create tensions, because users who trust each other through ratings still demand consumer safeguards that require command-and-control structures.
subjectOf.abstract: While people are willing to trust others by way of user ratings, they also require safeguards for consumers that typically require command-and-control centralized structures.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization and Feedback Effects (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808852
scope_conditions: applies to internet platform companies such as eBay and Amazon
